items.title_zh: AxonOS 社区雷达：开放脑机接口领域动态地图
items.title_en: AxonOS Community Radar: Living Map of the Open BCI Field
bullets_zh: AxonOS Radar是自动更新的开放脑机接口领域社区地图。
它追踪AxonOS体系下的BCI软件基础设施与生态项目。
适合发现与非侵入式EEG/BCI开发相关的工具。
bullets_en: AxonOS Radar is an auto-updated community map of the open brain-computer-interface field.
It tracks BCI software infrastructure and ecosystem projects under the AxonOS umbrella.
Useful for discovering tools relevant to non-invasive EEG/BCI development.
items.brief: 自动更新开放BCI生态地图，便于发现非侵入式BCI项目与工具。
items.brief_en: Auto-updated map of the open BCI ecosystem for discovering non-invasive BCI projects and tools.
items.raw_excerpt: AxonOS Radar — a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field. An AxonOS community project.

items.title_zh: API Evangelist对BrainCo公开API的第三方档案
items.title_en: API Evangelist Profile of BrainCo's Public API Surface
bullets_zh: API Evangelist维护了关于BrainCo公开API的独立第三方档案。
BrainCo被描述为由哈佛创新实验室创立、开发非侵入式BCI硬件与开发者SDK的神经技术公司。
该仓库帮助开发者了解消费级与研究级BCI设备周围的可用API。
bullets_en: API Evangelist maintains an independent third-party profile of BrainCo's public API surface.
BrainCo is described as a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
The repo helps developers understand available APIs around consumer and research BCI devices.
items.brief: 记录BrainCo非侵入式BCI硬件与SDK公开接口，助开发者集成。
items.brief_en: Profiles BrainCo's public API surface for non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

items.title_zh: 实时EEG脑机接口后端系统
bullets_zh: 该项目是用于实时连续EEG处理的神经工程后端系统。
它使用少样本迁移学习与DSP解码物理运动想象。
其目标是在非侵入式BCI设置中驱动真实硬件执行器。
bullets_en: The project is a backend neuro-engineering system for live continuous EEG processing.
It uses few-shot transfer learning and DSP to decode physical motor imagery.
It targets real-world hardware actuation in non-invasive BCI setups.
items.brief: 实时处理连续EEG，用少样本迁移学习与DSP解码运动想象。
items.brief_en: Processes continuous EEG in real time, decoding motor imagery with few-shot transfer learning and DSP.
items.raw_excerpt: Backend neuro-engineering system for live continuous EEG processing. Uses Few-Shot Transfer Learning and DSP to decode physical motor imagery for real-world hardware actuation.

bullets_zh: 该GitHub项目提供EEG-Deformer卷积Transformer的PyTorch实现。
它旨在从EEG信号解码心理状态，用于脑机接口。
它与基于非侵入式EEG的BCI模型开发和实验相关。
bullets_en: This GitHub project provides a PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer.
It is intended to decode mental states from EEG signals for brain-computer interfaces.
It is relevant to non-invasive EEG-based BCI model development and experimentation.
items.brief: 用卷积Transformer从EEG解码心理状态，适合非侵入式BCI研究。
items.brief_en: PyTorch EEG-Deformer implementation that decodes mental states from EEG for non-invasive BCI research.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode mental states from EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer for brain-computer interfaces.

items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK Open EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 2026年9月20日发布的GitHub项目，构建覆盖8–64通道的开源ADS1299脑电/BCI生态。
集成MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA参考包、Verilog RTL、PC/移动/Linux集成及Python/MATLAB/R分析工具。
其广度支持非侵入式EEG BCI开发的验证、教学和研究。
bullets_en: GitHub project published on 20 Sep 2026 builds an open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem for 8–64-channel systems.
It bundles MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, and Python/MATLAB/R analysis tools.
The breadth supports validation, education, and research in non-invasive EEG-based BCI development.
items.brief: 开源ADS1299脑电/BCI软硬件生态，服务非侵入式研究。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI hardware and software ecosystem for non-invasive research and development.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

items.title_zh: 脑机接口监管情报追踪器
bullets_zh: 2026年9月20日发布的GitHub项目，采集并展示与脑机接口相关的法律/监管法规。
提供UI用于监测BCI监管变化，而非进行医疗器械营销宣传。
该工具可帮助非侵入式BCI开发者跟踪合规相关法律动态。
bullets_en: GitHub project published on 20 Sep 2026 collects and displays legal/regulatory acts relevant to brain-computer interfaces.
It provides a UI for monitoring BCI regulatory changes rather than making device marketing claims.
The tool can help non-invasive BCI developers track compliance-relevant legal developments.
items.brief: 追踪脑机接口相关法规的采集与展示工具，服务合规监测。
items.brief_en: Tool for tracking BCI-related legal acts and regulatory intelligence, useful for compliance monitoring.
items.raw_excerpt: BCI Regulatory Intelligence — legal act tracking collector & UI

bullets_zh: BrainFlow 支持 OpenBCI、Galea、Cyton、Ganglion、NeuroMD、BrainBit、Callibri 等板卡。
文档涵盖设备设置、数据流、回放、合成数据和 API 使用。
它适合构建消费级非侵入式 EEG/BCI 应用。
bullets_en: BrainFlow supports OpenBCI, Galea, Cyton, Ganglion, NeuroMD, BrainBit, Callibri, and other boards.
The documentation covers board setup, streaming, playback, synthetic data, and API usage.
It is useful for building consumer non-invasive EEG/BCI applications.

items.title_zh: Mind Monitor 脑电监测软件

Useful as an entry-level tutorial resource for Muse-style BCI experiments.
